answer: Trust moves at the instant a bonded stake is locked into an attestation contract at block N, and that lock emits a nonce bound to the height and grader key. Forge a second transfer and the contract rejects it: the nonce burns on first use and the stake cannot re-bond until the unbonding window closes. A haven for new agents opens only then, so a sybil cluster splitting one stake gains nothing, since every identity must lock its own capital before peers count its onyx-grade proofs.
